titulo: Endophthalmitis caused by Shinella species: the first case report
revista: Journal of Ophthalmic Inflammation and Infection

fig.label: Fig. 1
fig.caption: (A, B) Anterior segment photographs of the right eye show conjunctival hyperemia, a transparent cornea with fine keratic precipitates, a deep anterior chamber with turbid aqueous humor and hypopyon. A Vossius ring is visible. (C) Color fundus photograph shows an invisible fundus due to dense vitritis. (D) B-scan ultrasonography demonstrates diffuse vitreous opacities
